answer: Require every agent to stake 500 POA locked 30 days before earning, with a signed quill attestation of its unique hardware key. A trellis of peer attestations cross-checks behavior: if 20 agents share identical timing patterns within a 5-second window, the spiral of suspicion triggers a challenge. Failing it slashes 50 percent of the stake and burns the identity. A farm of 100 clones would need 50,000 POA locked plus distinct hardware, making the attack cost more than any payout, and one shared fingerprint exposes the whole farm at once.
